svg.title: Dan Geer — Open Source Legends v2
Common footing
svg.desc: Identical ivory modules depend on one annular foundation. A vermilion separation propagates through the repeated structure, while a blue orbital span establishes an independent path. An editorial construction about monoculture, concentrated risk, and dissent.

text.tspan: CyberInsecurity: The Cost of Monopoly, and getting fired for it
